meta.name: Mom's Backyard
meta.coordinates: Origin = outside NW corner of the pool house slab. x runs along the 30' side toward the drawing's east (right side of the floor plan). y runs toward the pool (drawing's south, bottom of the floor plan). Heights (z) are measured up from the top of the slab.
meta.confidence: Each item is 'stated' (written on the drawing), 'drawn' (measured from the drawing at its scale), or 'assumed'. Anything 'needs_input' is not on the drawings at all.

compass.note: The drawing labels the right side EAST and also calls it the 'Sunset End' with the setting sun drawn there. The sun sets in the WEST, so one of the two is wrong. Layout is unaffected; only sun direction and shadows depend on this.

walls.note: between storage and bath; meets the fireplace's east corner

rooms.label: Bath + Changing
rooms.confidence: stated 10' x 8' nominal; drawn 9' x 7' clear

porch.label: Covered porch
porch.ceiling: vaulted, stained wood, exposed timber beams

shadePocket.note: recessed roller shade pocket in the beam soffit

columns.spacing: 10'-0" on center along the pool side, 9'-0" on center on the sides
columns.note: Drawn centered on the slab edge/corner.

fireplace.confidence: stated: 10' mass, 5' firebox, 16" hearth, 8' mantel. Everything else drawn.

roof.confidence: stated (ridge position worked out from the 8:12 pitch; it checks against the stated heights)

leanTo.label: Equipment lean-to
leanTo.confidence: stated: size, gravel, metal 3:12. Roof heights drawn.

outdoorKitchen.label: Outdoor kitchen
outdoorKitchen.confidence: stated 12'-6" run; depth and position drawn
outdoorKitchen.note: This is the drawn starting layout. In the app the kitchen layout can be changed (Stage 3); the porch it sits on cannot.

seatingArea.label: Fireplace seating
seatingArea.note: Guide only, not built geometry. Labeled 19'-0" clear; drawn 18'-6".

layoutAlongYard.order: pool house -> 4' deck -> pool (32' long) -> 8' deck -> house back porch, all on one center line
layoutAlongYard.confidence: stated by Lindsay: pool directly behind the house, pool house directly behind the pool

pool.status: existing (in photos, under a winter cover)
pool.longSide: runs away from the house (the 16' end faces the house)

steps.confidence: location stated; size and shape assumed (8' wide, centered)

pool.confidence: stated: rectangle, 16' x 32', steps at house end. From photos: long side runs away from the house. Assumed: depths, step size.

trenchDrain.note: along the foot of the back porch steps

poolDeck.confidence: stated widths. Assumed: the 4' back strip of deck meets the pool house porch slab with no gap.

gates.note: on the way to the rinse station

fence.confidence: assumed. Wanted, but no line given. Proposed along both long edges of the deck, tying into the house and the pool house's enclosed back section.

lawn.note: Open acreage. Shown as 300' x 300' of grass around the site with a tree line beyond. Playhouse and pool equipment seen in the photos on the left side (from the house) are not modeled.

existingHouse.role: backdrop only - not a measured drawing

wing.note: projects toward the pool on the left side (from the house)

existingHouse.confidence: estimated from photos. Only fixed fact: the back porch edge is 8' from the pool and centered on it.

styleFromPhotos.brickFront: dark charcoal-brown brick base, about 3' high
styleFromPhotos.brickBack: red-orange blend brick with light mortar on the back porch floor, steps and base
styleFromPhotos.roof: hip roof, dark brown-charcoal architectural shingles, shed dormer with three windows on the front
styleFromPhotos.trim: white trim, fascia, gutters and downspouts
styleFromPhotos.columns: front: square painted columns. Back porch: dark posts
styleFromPhotos.doors: front: dark stained wood double door with glass. Back: white French doors
styleFromPhotos.lights: black lantern sconces in front; recessed soffit lights at the back
